reply.description: The SMS to send to the lead, at most 320 characters. null to send nothing, e.g. when the lead only says thanks after booking.

stage.description: Where the conversation is after this reply.

objection.description: True if the lead's latest message pushes back on having a call (too busy, not interested, insurance is a rip-off).

unsubscribe.description: True if the lead's latest message asks not to be contacted again, in any wording.

abusive.description: True if the lead's latest message is abusive or threatening.

note.description: One short line for the people reviewing this conversation: why you replied this way.
